To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most frequent metaphors in English are conventional, systematic, and productive.

(a) metaphorical language conventions are not as numerous as has been claimed; (b) the conventions are not as arbitrary as has been claimed, but rather are motivated by a variety of factors; and (c) the conventions are more numerous than has been claimed for the conventional metaphorical language that occurs within a single genre, and that they are more numerous than claimed for a given genre of conventional metaphorical language.
(i) metaphor is a highly conventionalized phenomenon, (ii) there are many different metaphorical conventions, and (iii) there are many conventional metaphorical conventions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an empirical methodology for the analysis of metaphor and metonymy in natural language corpora, and the development of a knowledge-based approach to the computational processing of these phenomena.
the construction of a large-scale knowledge-base of English linguistic conventions.
the construction of a comprehensive knowledge base of metaphorical conventions, and the development of a computational system for the automatic detection of metaphorical expressions in running text.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the construction of Meta-Bank is an ongoing process.
we have developed an empirically grounded knowledge base that can be used to identify metaphorical expressions in text, that is, expressions that are likely to be used in a metaphorical sense.
we have a knowledge-base of English metaphoric conventions that is empirically derived, theoretically motivated, and machine-readable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a methodology for constructing a knowledge-base of English metaphoric conventions that can be used in the development of natural language processing systems.
the construction of a large knowledge-base of metaphoric language conventions is a practical and feasible undertaking.
MetaBank is a knowledge-base of conventional metaphorical expressions that can be used in a variety of ways, including the automatic detection and disambiguation of metaphors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a knowledge-base of conventional metaphoric language is feasible.
it is feasible to construct a knowledge-base of metaphorical language that is both empirically grounded and theoretically motivated.
a knowledge-based approach to metaphor is feasible.
